description: This file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractOperation' in the TensorFlow Java API, providing common functionalities for operation implementations such as retrieving outputs, tensor shapes, data types, native handles, and tensors in eager mode.

methods.name: outputList
methods.description: Returns an array of outputs starting from a specified index, with given length.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Returns a typed output at the specified index.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the operation including its type and name.

methods.name: getUnsafeNativeHandle
methods.description: Returns the native handle associated with a specific output index; differs depending on execution environment (eager or graph mode).

methods.name: shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the tensor at a specific output index.

methods.name: dtype
methods.description: Returns the data type of the tensor at a specific output index.

methods.name: tensor
methods.description: Returns the tensor at a specific output index, supported in eager mode.
